segments.text: I want to end this video on a positive note.
I come from a faith as a Hindu.
I can put some red sander on a stone and it becomes sacred and people will worship it.

It's the faith that I bring in to the artifact, to the project that makes it sacred.
The power is in our hands.
When you start the work, what's the intention behind it?
Is it to create a better world?
If your intention is pure, I believe the resources of our earth is at your disposal.
It might not be easy but you can definitely shape God out of a piece of rock.

You can create a city out of a desert and we can bring life to a planet that has none.
